updates.title: Prelaunch deep-dive project bible completed
updates.summary: The prelaunch plan now consolidates engine references, asset provenance, story and title pitches, item and boss ideas, difficulty and co-op feasibility, model routing, and the minimal Day-1 Codex plan.

updates.title: Public-feed privacy validation strengthened
updates.summary: The public update pipeline now blocks additional credential, network-path, machine-path, and unapproved image-host patterns before website data can be published.

updates.title: Public feed automation prepared
updates.summary: The sanitized public-feed pipeline and Site deployment checks are configured. One minimal Site edit is still required to bind the existing dashboard panels to the public JSON feeds without redesigning the Site.

updates.title: Remastered-style graphics direction confirmed
updates.summary: OOT2 remains a new direct sequel to Ocarina of Time. Remastered-style describes the visual target only.
